content.text: May I help you?Hi there! I’m Wildcat. Ask me your questions!Questions? Ask WildcatAsk WildcatTranscript with Wildcat on 4/1/2026, 9:25:02 PMOpens in a new window COST OF ATTENDANCE The cost of attendance (also known as a budget) is the average cost of attending Villanova University for the year (fall and spring semesters). It is comprised of direct and indirect costs. Direct costs are items that the student will be billed for, such as tuition and fees, whereas indirect costs are expenses the student is not billed for but may need funding for, such as transportation, supplies, etc. 2026-2027 Academic Year Traditional Undergraduate Full-Time Day Program On/Off-Campus 2026-2027 Academic Year Direct Costs (billable)** Tuition: $72,990 (semester tuition rate: 36,495) Student Services Fee: $1,024 Housing: $10,314* Food/Meals: $9,040* Books: $600 Indirect Costs (non-billed) Supplies: $560** Personal: $1,450 Transportation: $850 Loan Fees: $58*** Total Estimated Cost of Attendance: $96,886 *This is an estimate. Actual charges are based on room and meal plan selected. If your housing status is not on campus, then the housing and meals amount is not billable. This represents your housing and meal allowance for financial aid purposes. **The Supplies amount listed above is for freshmen. Returning Undergraduate Students have a supplies expense of $160. ***The Loan Fee amount is dependent on a student's grade level, and therefore may be more. The amount listed above is for freshman grade level. Depending on your program of study, you may be assessed additional fees. Additional fees may be assessed, please visit the Bursar's website to view all fees. While not included in the determination of your eligibility for financial aid, students that need health insurance may purchase a plan through the University at a cost of approximately $2,580 a year.
